name: liquid-fill
title: Liquid Fill
description: A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing surface and bubbles until the mark is solid. Give it any closed shape as the shape path variable.
useWhen: A beverage, fintech or utility brand wants a reveal about filling up, loading or topping off.
Your mark is a simple closed shape you can express as one SVG path, and the sting should fill it.
avoidWhen: Your logo is a detailed image rather than a single closed shape: wrap it with spotlight or orbit-lock.
The mark should feel bouncy and soft rather than fluid: use inflate.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Wordmark that slides out beside the mark once it is full. Leave empty for the mark alone.

variables.label: Shape path
variables.description: Mark outline as SVG path data inside a 100 by 100 box. Defaults to a rounded square.
